verdict.rationale: Numeral documents continual nexus monitoring across US and global jurisdictions, with per-jurisdiction economic thresholds alongside current sales and transaction counts, fed by transactions recorded through its integrations. However, its documented alerts fire "when you cross nexus," not ahead of a threshold. Missing for 10: proactive alerts before a threshold is crossed, configurable approaching-threshold warnings, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the monitoring and alerting.
